summary.text: Grace Diaz is a Democratic member of the Rhode Island House of Representatives, representing District 11 since 2005, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026; Ballotpedia lists her as the only candidate. She is a child care consultant.

paragraphs.text: Grace Diaz earned a B.A. in human services from Springfield College in 2008 and an M.A. in human services and management leadership from Springfield College in 2010.
Her professional experience includes working as a self-employed child care consultant.
Diaz was a superdelegate to the 2016 Democratic National Convention and supported Hillary Clinton for the nomination.
She has five children, according to Ballotpedia.
